Ana (Docs): hey team — opened a small PR to replace the old cost/latency dashboard example with the new cost-breakdown widget and update the tracehook snippet. link: https://redwood.dev/prs/12345 :wave:

Marco (Eng-ML): also watch for the kv-cache metric rename — cost attribution field moved from `cost_usd` to `billing_cost_usd` in the schema. examples referencing old name will break dashboards.

Sofia (SDK): quick snippet I plan to add for python (to replace inline example):
```python
from redwood import TracingHook
hook = TracingHook(service="checkout", trace_key="order_id")
hook.attach()
# now spans will include trace_key -> order_id mapping
```
Sofia (SDK): for node:
```js
const { TracingHook } = require('@redwood/sdk')
const hook = new TracingHook({ service: 'checkout', traceKey: 'order_id' })
hook.attach()
```
Ana (Docs): perfect. can you also add a one-liner about not sending PII as trace_key? compliance asked for that note.
Sofia (SDK): noted — will add: "do not send PII in trace keys; prefer hashed identifiers."
